Event Description:  
 Arts & Crafts club, SVCE with the support from department of English, organized one day seminar on 
“Human Values and Professional Ethics”. The programme sta rted with lighting the lamp and prayer song.  
Principal Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy encouraged the students  to utilize the opportunity  to know the importance of 
human values and professional ethics. The Chief Guest Mr. M. Harinath started the session explaining about the 
life cycle since infancy to  the end of the life; how the way of thinking get changes; the impact of surroundings  
and hereditary. He detailed that human values are the ideals or principles that help in making judgment of what 
is more important besides referring to our view point that determines our behavior on certain situations. The 
human values are individual behavioral assets those could be used to measure persons achievements. Basic 

inherent human values give idea about kindness, sympathy, loyalty, love, peace, honesty, truth that influences 
or increases goodness and nature of human being in the society. The human values cherish and help to 
understand the motivation, attitude and behavior to interp ret right or wrong.  It also provides the rules to 
understand humanity and institution. 
Detailing about professional ethics ; he emphasized both human values and professional ethics are 
complementary to each other; they are one of the branches of philosophy, especially moral philosophy. Both are 
important in every sphere. The professional ethics are uniform rules those provide moral perspective for 
deciding how to act and for analyzing issues.  The human values convey the personal conviction and ethics give 
the principles and standards of conduct about moral duties in an organization. The seminar inspired the students 
in cultivating ethics and values. Principal, Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy honored the Chief Guest felicitating with 
shawl and memento. 
Targeted Audience:  
1st,2nd and 3rdYear Students.
